name: Mission Tactics
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of three Mission Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase, that tactic is active and its effects apply to all units from your army with this ability. Each can be selected only once per battle. Furor: weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Malleus: weapons equipped by ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army have [LETHAL HITS]. Purgatus: each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army makes an attack, if a Critical Hit is scored, that attack has [PRECISION].

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of three Combat Doctrines. Until the start of your next Command phase, it is active and applies to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. Each Combat Doctrine can only be selected once per battle. Devastator Doctrine: the unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: the unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: the unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.
